plan: Study the infinite-canvas reference repo's canvas core implementation and the current project's novel module + persistence layer, then design the port architecture and integration plan. Output: findings.md with file-by-file port map and target src/shared/canvas/ structure.
actions: Read core canvas files: infinite-canvas.tsx (viewport pan/zoom/grid, controlled component), canvas-connections.tsx (SVG bezier edges), canvas-mini-map.tsx (world-bounds minimap), canvas-context-menu.tsx (right-click menu), canvas-zoom-controls.tsx (zoom dock), canvas-theme.ts (light/dark tokens), types/canvas.ts (Position/ViewportTransform/CanvasNodeData/CanvasConnection/SelectionBox/ContextMenuState).
Grepped project.tsx (178KB) for undo/redo: confirmed manual history stack via historyRef useRef {past,future} with 400ms debounced commit, historyPausedRef guard, undoCanvas/redoCanvas callbacks.

Read current project: novel/types.ts (full domain model — StoryEntity/EntityRelation/TimelineEvent/OutlineNode/PlotThread/Foreshadowing), novel/db.ts (NovelDatabase Dexie v5, VersionedRecord pattern, appendOperation change log), novel/PlanningWorkspace.tsx (architecture/outline/matrix modes, tree+detail layout).
Confirmed tech stack alignment: both projects use React + Vite + TypeScript + Ant Design + Tailwind + Zustand + Dexie.

Wrote findings.md with: reference file port map (generic vs. AI-specific), state ownership analysis, generic CanvasNode<T>/CanvasEdge type design, target src/shared/canvas/ folder structure, persistence design (new canvasLayouts Dexie store v6), and per-panel integration pattern for the 4 novel panels.

verification.summary: findings.md exists with port architecture, file map, generic node type, persistence design, and 4-panel integration plan.

verification: Reference repo clone verified at .goal/goals/canvas-port/tmp/infinite-canvas/web/src/components/canvas/ with 35 canvas component files.
Confirmed reference InfiniteCanvas is a controlled component (viewport + onViewportChange props) — portable without AI coupling.
Confirmed novel NovelWorkspaceView union already includes relations/timeline/board keys suitable for canvas views.
selfReflection: The reference canvas core is cleanly separable from AI image generation: InfiniteCanvas (185 lines), CanvasEdges (72), Minimap (121), ContextMenu (37), ZoomControls (76) are all generic controlled components totaling ~490 lines. The 718-line CanvasNode is AI-specific and must be replaced with a new generic CanvasNodeShell. Undo/redo is a simple debounced stack — extractable into a useCanvasHistory hook. The current project's Dexie/VersionedRecord pattern and useLiveQuery reactive queries integrate naturally with a per-panel CanvasLayout record. No architectural blockers identified.

selfAssessment.reason: Research loop produced a concrete port map and integration design with no open blockers; scope (core + node interactions, 4 panels, IndexedDB persistence) is well-defined and achievable.

successSignalUpdates.text: Port architecture documented in findings.md: file-by-file port map, generic CanvasNode<T>/CanvasEdge types, target src/shared/canvas/ structure, IndexedDB persistence design, and 4-panel integration plan.

Reusable canvas base capability exists under src/shared/canvas/ with InfiniteCanvas (pan/zoom/grid), CanvasEdges, Minimap, ContextMenu, ZoomControls, CanvasNodeShell, useCanvasHistory, useCanvasKeyboard — verified by passing component/unit tests.
Canvas layout persists to IndexedDB via new canvasLayouts store in NovelDatabase; save-to-reload-to-restore round-trip verified by test.
Character relationship panel renders as canvas: StoryEntity (kind=character) nodes connected by EntityRelation edges, backed by CanvasLayout persistence and live-synced to domain data.
Plot timeline panel renders as canvas: TimelineEvent nodes positioned by narrativeOrder with cause-to-consequence edges and parallelGroup swimlanes, backed by persistence.
Worldview/setting map panel renders as canvas: non-character StoryEntity nodes grouped by kind (location/organization/faction/item/species/rule/ability/term), backed by persistence.
Planning workspace offers a canvas board mode mixing outline/entity/thread nodes with parent-child and cross-reference edges, alongside existing architecture/outline/matrix modes.

nextDirection: Begin implementation of src/shared/canvas/ core: port types.ts, canvas-theme.ts, InfiniteCanvas.tsx, CanvasEdges.tsx, CanvasMinimap.tsx, CanvasContextMenu.tsx, CanvasZoomControls.tsx from the reference (adapting imports/theme), then build the new generic CanvasNodeShell.tsx and useCanvasHistory/useCanvasKeyboard hooks. Verify with a component test that the canvas renders, pans, and zooms.

artifactRefs.evidence: findings.md contains the port architecture: reference file port map (InfiniteCanvas/CanvasEdges/Minimap/ContextMenu/ZoomControls port as-is, CanvasNode redesigned), generic CanvasNode<T>/CanvasEdge types, target src/shared/canvas/ folder structure, CanvasLayout Dexie persistence schema, and 4-panel integration plan.
